title: Chicken Shawarma Sheet Pan with Chickpeas
description: Warmly spiced chicken thighs and chickpeas roasted golden with Middle Eastern aromatics — tender, fiber-rich and meal-prep ready.
ingredients: 0.75 tsp each garlic and onion powder
steps: Toss the chicken, vegetables and chickpeas with oil and spices.
Spread in an even layer on a sheet pan.
Roast at 425F for 30-35 minutes until the chicken is cooked through, broiling 2 minutes for char if you like.

source.label: Adapted from Skinnytaste sheet pan chicken shawarma

notes: Chickpeas boost fiber to around 7.5g per serving — prep the vegetables the night before for a hands-off weeknight dinner.
